learning_objective: 🎯 Master the art of beautiful handwriting and learn how to combine bold text and striking visuals to communicate powerful messages!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Calligraphy is the visual art of writing beautifully using special pens, nibs, or brushes. It treats letters not just as text, but as a form of artistic design.
Typography is the style and appearance of printed matter. While calligraphy is done by hand, typography is choosing the right font style, size, and spacing to make text readable and impactful.
A successful poster needs three things: 1) A catchy and short Slogan (title), 2) A striking and relevant Visual (illustration or photo), and 3) Necessary Details (time, date, or message).
Hierarchy means guiding the viewer's eye to what is most important first. The main slogan should be the largest, followed by the image, and then the smaller supporting text at the bottom.

Colors communicate emotion. Red grabs attention and shows urgency (e.g., 'Stop Pollution'), while green shows nature and peace (e.g., 'Save Trees'). High contrast between text and background is vital for readability.

fun_activity.title: 📢 Design a Cause
fun_activity.instructions: Pick an environmental issue (like Save Water or Stop Plastic). Design a mini-poster on an A4 sheet. Use only 4 words for your slogan, make the letters thick and bold, and draw one large, simple icon to represent the issue!

exam_tips: 📌 Always remember: A poster must be readable from a distance. Do not clutter it with too much text.
📌 Define Calligraphy as the 'art of beautiful handwriting'.
📌 Visual hierarchy is crucial—make the most important message the largest and boldest element on the page.
quick_recap: ⭐ The primary goal of a poster is to communicate a specific message quickly and effectively.
⭐ Calligraphy uses specialized tools like flat-tipped markers, fountain pens, or bamboo brushes.
⭐ A good layout balances the positive space (text/images) and negative space (empty background).
